policy: Targeted niqqud: only the tokens listed here are pointed in narration.he.niqqud.txt. A token is listed when an unpointed reading is ambiguous or easy to mispronounce. Every other word stays unpointed on purpose; pointing every word adds marks that a voice engine may read worse, and errors in full niqqud are hard to review. No entry is verified as audio: only listening to Noam's chosen HeyGen voice can confirm it.

statusValues.text-checked: Pointing checked against standard Hebrew grammar for this context; still needs listening.
statusValues.needs-listening-priority: A real alternative pronunciation exists, or a TTS engine is likely to pick the wrong one. Listen to this word first.

entries.rationale: Power (exponent). Unpointed it can be read khazaka, 'strong' (fem.).
As חזקה, with the article.
Construct form used to read powers aloud: 'three be-khezkat four'.
Plural of חֶזְקָה. Same sound as 'strong' (fem. pl.), so meaning comes from context; pointed for consistency with the singular.
Exponent. Standard term is מַעֲרִיךְ (ma'arikh). Speakers and engines also say me'arekh; check that the voice says ma'arikh.
As המעריך, with ל + article.
Base of a power. Unambiguous, pointed because it is the paired term to מעריך in the same sentence.
'Squared'. Ktiv male keeps the י (hiriq male), so stripping the marks gives the post's spelling. Furtive patah under the final ע so the ending is -ua.
As in שורש ריבועי, 'square root'. Ktiv male keeps the י.
Root. Spelled with ו (ktiv male) in the post, so the holam is on the ו and stripping the marks gives the same letters.
As שורש, with the article (dagesh in ש).
'Is raised' (to a power), hof'al participle. Unpointed it can be read ma'ale ('raises').
Multiplication (noun). Unpointed it can be read kafal, 'he doubled'.
'With the multiplication' (definite, as in מתחילים בכפל).
'That multiplication…'.
'Who calculates'. Unpointed it can be read she-makhshev, 'that a computer'.
Teen numbers (ארבע עשרה, חמש עשרה, שמונה עשרה). The scripts never use עשרה for 10 (asara); if one ever does, use a per-segment override.
'Whole' (fem.). Unpointed it can be read as the name Shlomo.
'Whole' (a whole page). Unpointed it can be read shilem, 'paid'.
'Were calculated' (pu'al). Unpointed it can be read khoshvu, 'think'.
'Was understood' (huf'al).
'To the power' (מועלה בחזקה, בחזקה זוגית). Unpointed it can be read be-khozka, 'by force'.
As בחזקה with ו (shuruk before ב).
As in 'the inverse of the second power'.
Plural with the article (חוקי החזקות).
As כפל, with the article.
As in קיצור לכפל חוזר.
As שורש with ו.
As הבסיס with ש.
'Square' (ריבוע מושלם). Ktiv male keeps the י.

rejected.reason: Ktiv male spells it with two ו; the pointed form שָׁוֶה has one, so pointing it changes the letters. Left unpointed (normally read shave). Listen for it.
Ktiv male spells it with two ו; the pointed form הַכְוָנָה has one. The scripts say הדרכה ('guidance') instead, which has a single clear reading.

unpointedOk.reason: Shares letters with שלם after prefix stripping, but מושלם (mushlam, 'perfect') has one reading.
